pr_title: Further changes that will successfully build osqueryd.exe and osqueryi.exe
pr_body:
This PR contains the set of changes necessary to produce a `osqueryd.exe` and `osqueryi.exe` on Windows. The ported over shell supports `readline` on POSIX and `linenoise-ng` on Windows and includes table autocompletion

Closes #2007
